items.text: Tampa Bay QB: Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) QUESTIONABLE after limited Thu/Fri; Bowles: 'trending in the right direction' but no starter named. Game-time decision; undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts if he can't go. Possible late QB change.
Tampa Bay (final): OUT - S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle), CB Josh Hayes (knee). QUESTIONABLE - OLB YaYa Diaby (knee). Sat: S J.J. Roberts elevated. IR - WR Jalen McMillan, LB Christian Rozeboom.

Detroit (final): C Cade Mays (ankle) OUT, placed on IR Sat. QUESTIONABLE - CB D.J. Reed (hip), CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder), CB Khalil Dorsey (ankle), RB Sione Vaki (ankle), DL Tyler Lacy (shoulder), LB Joe Bachie (knee). S Kerby Joseph returns (no designation). Sat: CB Nick Whiteside signed, LB Owen Pappoe elevated. DE Aidan Hutchinson (season), LB Jack Campbell (IR). Jared Goff starts.

adjust.reason: Detroit is without DE Hutchinson, LB Campbell and C Mays with three corners questionable, which outweighs Tampa Bay missing S Winfield and CB Hayes. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
